summary: AI Credit System Testing - All 15 backend tests passed. Frontend credit popup verified on Product Description Generator, AI Assistant, AI Tools (Logo Creator - high cost), and Floating Assistant. Credit modal with Admin Usage Summary verified. Credit costs correctly assigned (Low=1, Medium=2, High=3). Monthly credits deducted before purchased credits. Failed AI actions do not deduct credits. Preflight endpoint returns correct warning logic for high-cost actions, low balance, and purchased credit usage.

GET /api/credits/preflight.description: Returns credit_cost, monthly_credits, purchased_credits, total_credits, sufficient_credits, should_show_popup, popup_reasons (high_cost_action, low_balance, purchased_credits_needed, cost_changed), will_use_purchased, monthly_credits_to_use, purchased_credits_to_use

GET /api/credits/preferences.description: Returns hide_ai_credit_popup (boolean) and acknowledged_costs (dict) per user/tenant

PUT /api/credits/preferences.description: Persists hide_ai_credit_popup and acknowledged_costs, verified with GET after PUT

GET /api/credits/balance.description: Returns monthly_credits, purchased_credits, total_credits, is_low_credits, low_credits_threshold

GET /api/credits/costs.description: Returns all 58+ AI actions with correct costs (1, 2, or 3). product_description=2, ai_business_assistant=2, historical_invoice_analysis=3, pricing_advisor=1, assistant_chat=2, assistant_parse_action=1

GET /api/credits/admin-summary.description: Returns balance, total_ai_credits_used, monthly_credits_consumed, purchased_credits_consumed, by_tool (list with action_type/credits_used/count), by_user, recent_usage. Visible in credit modal for admin/owner.

GET /api/credits/history.description: Returns paginated transaction history with tenant_id, transaction_type, amount, balance_after

GET /api/credits/packs.description: Returns 3 credit packs: pack_100 ($10), pack_300 ($25 POPULAR), pack_1000 ($60 40% OFF)

Invalid tool no credit deduction.description: POST /api/ai/generate with invalid tool returns 400/500 without deducting credits

Monthly credits deducted first.description: Preflight correctly calculates monthly_credits_to_use before purchased_credits_to_use

AI Credit Confirmation Dialog - Product.description: Dialog appears with action name, 2 credit cost, monthly/purchased/total balances, warning badges (Confirmation enabled, Cost changed), hide checkbox with explanation, Cancel/Continue buttons

AI Credit Confirmation Dialog - AI Assis.description: Dialog appears when sending message in AI Business Assistant chat

AI Credit Confirmation Dialog - AI Tools.description: Logo Creator (3 credits) shows dialog with 'High-cost action' badge, dialog reappears even when hide preference is set due to warning condition

AI Credit Confirmation Dialog - Floating.description: Floating Assistant chat triggers credit confirmation dialog

Credit Balance in Header.description: Credit balance button shows total balance, clicking opens credit modal with balances, buy packs, and admin usage summary

Admin AI Usage Summary in Modal.description: Shows Total Used, Monthly Consumed, Purchased Consumed, Top Tools (with credit counts), Recent Usage (with timestamps and success status)

Hide Preference Warning Logic.description: Popup reappears on warning cases (high-cost action, cost changed) even when hide preference is enabled. Checkbox explanation states: 'The popup will still reappear for high-cost actions, low-balance warnings, cost changes, or when purchased credits will be used.'

critical_code_review_comments: credits.py: Preflight endpoint correctly calculates warning reasons and deduction plan
credit_service.py: preview_credit_usage, deduct_credits_after_success, log_failed_ai_usage functions properly integrated
founders_config.py: AI_CREDIT_COSTS dict maps 58+ AI actions to 1/2/3 credits based on compute intensity
ai.py: All AI endpoints check credits via preview_credit_usage before execution, deduct only after success
AICreditConfirmationDialog.js: Shows action name, cost, balances, warning badges, hide checkbox with proper explanation
CreditBalance.js: Header button shows balance, modal shows buy packs and admin usage summary for admin/owner

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All credit popup and modal features verified

seed_data_creation: None - used existing account with 999995 monthly credits and 999999 purchased credits
